title: Grateful Dead Live at Aqua Theater on 1969-08-21
source: S:Cm,C,D,CDR [Soundboard -> Bear's Cassette master -> Cassette -> DAT -> CD]

ai_review.summary: Good-quality soundboard capture of a mellow 1969 Seattle show with an unusually brief Dark Star and guest flute on China Cat Sunflower, making it more historic than essential.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its solid sound quality despite being a modest, mellow performance. Highlights include a six‑minute Dark Star that sets a brevity record and a unique flute cameo on China Cat Sunflower, though many reviewers feel the show lacks the mind‑melting intensity of other late‑60s dates.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (3.25) across four reviews with mixed comments; sound quality is good but the musical performance is viewed as more of a curiosity than a standout show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality described as good and clear; no major dropouts or mix issues noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mellow overall vibe with a very short Dark Star and the novelty of a guest flautist, resulting in a relaxed but not particularly mind‑melting set.
